findings.body: The package-lock.json guard excludes Vitest and Jest repositories using pnpm or Yarn, even when adoption receives an explicit command such as `pnpm exec vitest run`. Their test tools have the required built-in changed-only mode, but fast_test remains unset and close continues running the full suite. The amended Done-when has no npm-only restriction; the ponytail comment does not satisfy that requirement. Generate the changed-only command using the repository's package manager. Jest explicitly supports forwarding CLI options through these managers: [Jest documentation](https://jestjs.io/docs/cli#using-with-package-manager).

findings.body: All three new command tests initialize repositories without commits, so they exercise _scaffold and never reach _adopt. The existing adoption test checks other settings at tests/test_live_adopt.py:49–54 but neither supplies a recognized test tool nor asserts fast_test. Removing the new adoption argument would therefore leave these tests passing. Add command-level adoption coverage that verifies Vitest and Jest receive changed-only commands and pytest leaves fast_test unset.
findings.title: Not done: Command-level tests for automatic fast_test during adoption

findings.body: _fast_test ignores the test command and chooses solely from dependencies, preferring Vitest whenever both tools are installed. A repository with pyproject.toml and frontend Vitest dependencies gets `test = "uv run pytest"` from src/forge/init.py:136 but a Vitest fast_test; adoption likewise ignores an explicit Jest or pytest --test command. src/forge/review.py:246–248 substitutes fast_test for the entire test command, so close checks a different suite and can omit all relevant tests. Base detection on the selected invocation rather than merely the presence of a dependency.
findings.title: Derive the fast command from the selected test invocation

findings.body: The generated bare npx invocation bypasses npm test and any arguments supplied during adoption. For example, adopting with `--test 'npm ci && npx jest --config config/jest.integration.js'` produces a fast_test without that configuration, changing how tests are discovered and executed. [Jest documents this configuration contract](https://jestjs.io/docs/cli#--configpath). Similarly, setup performed by npm's pretest hook is omitted. Preserve the configured invocation and required setup when adding the changed-only option, rather than replacing it with a generic runner command.
findings.title: Preserve the test runner's configuration and setup

why: Repos only get change-based test runs at close if someone sets fast_test by hand, so most closes still run the full suite that CI runs again
